name: Reiki
overview: Scripture warns believers to avoid practices associated with enchantment and the abominations of surrounding nations, emphasizing obedience to God's commands rather than adopting foreign spiritual methods (Leviticus 19:26; Deuteronomy 18:9). True power and healing come through faith in Christ, who empowers believers to perform works greater than His own (John 14:12). Wisdom calls for building one's life on God's truth, not on practices like Reiki, which lack biblical foundation and may lead to spiritual harm (Proverbs 14:1). Believers are also urged to maintain sober judgment, recognizing the measure of faith God has given them rather than seeking spiritual experiences outside His provision (Romans 12:3).
